updates.tweet_text: A game changer for me was realizing markets can't be engaged all day. Most price action is noise & has little edge. I used to spend 8rs a day trading, and lost. Now, its <15 mins. Everyday is a mission: Plan my spots, get in, take my piece/get into a runner, get out and protect
updates.notes: No prices mentioned at all. Tweet is philosophical/motivational commentary about trading approach and time management, not actionable level identification.
